title: The High-Speed SPI Protocol
summary: Transmit megabits per second to displays and radios with 4-wire SPI (MOSI, MISO, SCK, CS).

steps.title: When Speed Matters: SPI vs I2C
steps.markdownContent: While I2C is great for slow environmental sensors, streaming graphics to a dot matrix display or reading radio packets at 2.4 GHz requires raw bandwidth. **SPI** (Serial Peripheral Interface) operates at up to **8 MHz** on an Arduino Uno—twenty times faster than standard I2C!

steps.title: The 4 SPI Lines & Shift Registers
steps.markdownContent:
SPI communicates via 4 dedicated synchronous lines:

- `MOSI` (Pin 11): **Master Out, Slave In** (Uno to module)
- `MISO` (Pin 12): **Master In, Slave Out** (Module to Uno)
- `SCK` (Pin 13): **Serial Clock** (Generated by Uno to latch bits)
- `CS / SS` (Pin 10): **Chip Select** (Pulled LOW to wake a specific peripheral)

SPI is **Full-Duplex**: data shifts out on MOSI at the exact same instant incoming data shifts in on MISO!

steps.title: Module Header Pinout Inspection
steps.markdownContent:
Inspect your high-speed peripherals:
1. Examine the MAX7219 8x8 Dot Matrix (`comp_15`) and RC522 RFID module (`comp_23`).
2. Locate the header labels: find `MOSI` (or `DIN`), `MISO` (or `DOUT`), `SCK` (or `CLK`), and `CS` (or `SS`/`SDA`).
3. Note: On Uno R3, hardware SPI pins are fixed to Pins 11, 12, 13, plus any digital pin for Chip Select.

questions.question: What does the term 'Full-Duplex' mean in SPI communication?
options: Data can be transmitted and received at the exact same instant
Only one device can transmit at a time

questions.question: Which line transmits data from the Arduino Master to the peripheral target?
How does the Arduino Master select which peripheral to talk to on an SPI bus?
options: By pulling that specific device's Chip Select (CS) line LOW
By broadcasting an I2C hex address

questions.question: Which hardware pins on an Arduino Uno serve as MOSI, MISO, and SCK?
options: Pin A4, Pin A5, Pin A6

questions.question: If you add 3 SPI devices to your Arduino, how many shared lines and dedicated lines do you need?
options: 3 shared lines (MOSI, MISO, SCK) and 3 dedicated CS lines

questions.question: In comparison to I2C, what is the main advantage of the SPI protocol?
options: Significantly higher data transfer speeds and simple shift-register hardware

questions.question: What electrical problem occurs if two SPI peripherals share the same CS line?
options: MISO bus contention: both peripherals attempt to drive the data return line simultaneously
